bio.start: I learned to code around 13 on a SA:MP server, then on FiveM projects: two multiplayer mods for GTA, where a few hundred players share one server. My first users, then, and the discovery that it takes only a handful more of them to bring down what ran perfectly well on its own. Since then it has been .NET, mostly backend.
bio.away: When I am not at my screen, you will probably find me hiking somewhere, or playing games when I am not trying to build one.
bio.invitation: If something here speaks to you, write to me. I answer.

summary.heading: In short
summary.body: This site does not measure its audience, does not profile anyone and sells nothing. It carries no third party script, no analytics tool and no ad network. There is therefore no consent banner to show, for want of a tracker to have accepted.

stored.heading: What is stored in your browser
stored.theme: Two values at most are written to your browser. The first, under the key {themeKey}, is kept in local storage and only if you switch between the light and dark themes. It is light or dark, nothing else.
stored.locale: The second, the cookie {localeCookie}, is written only if you change the language from the switcher in the header. It holds the language code you chose, and lets a later visit open in that language rather than guessing from your browser's settings.
stored.neverLeaves: Neither value identifies you, and neither is used to track you. You can delete both at any time by clearing this site's data from your browser settings.
stored.consent: Both are strictly necessary to a service you asked for, namely remembering a display preference and a language, so they fall outside prior consent under the CNIL's guidelines.

logs.heading: Host logs
logs.processor: The site is hosted by {host}, acting as a processor within the meaning of the GDPR. Like any host, {host} technically records the requests it receives: IP address, date and time, page requested, browser type. These logs serve to provide the service, to secure it and to diagnose failures. This processing rests on the legitimate interest in running a site that is available and safe.
logs.notRead: I do not consult these logs, keep no copy of them and draw no statistics from them. Their retention period is set by the host alone, under the rules described in its <link>privacy policy</link>.
logs.transfer: As {host} is established in the United States, a transfer of data outside the European Union takes place. It is governed by the European Commission's standard contractual clauses, and by {host}'s certification under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.

writing.heading: If you write to me
writing.body: There is no form on this site. If you write to me at <mail>{email}</mail>, your address and the content of your message are used only to reply to you, and stay in my mailbox. They are neither passed on nor reused for other purposes.

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.body: The General Data Protection Regulation gives you rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and portability over your data. To exercise them, write to <mail>{email}</mail>.
rights.complaint: If a reply does not satisfy you, you may refer the matter to the French data protection authority: <cnil>www.cnil.fr</cnil>.

controller.heading: Data controller
controller.body: The data controller is {name}, reachable at <mail>{email}</mail>. The only processor is {host}, for the hosting described above. No data is passed to any other recipient. The publishing details appear in the <legal>legal notice</legal>.
